description:
About the company
 Our client is a biotechnology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Contribute across both the interface and data processing layers of a software product, building new functionality and automating laboratory and analysis work. Collaborate with scientists and external-facing colleagues to deliver dependable production code.
 What you'll do
 - Deliver end-to-end functionality spanning user-facing screens and server-side processing.
 - Build learning-based tools that identify edges between populations in lab measurement data.
 - Streamline repeatable laboratory and analysis processes through software.
 - Release reliable code on projects with tight deadlines and serious consequences.
 - Bring a customer-minded approach to product work, discussing ideas directly with scientists and external partners.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - A record of delivering software to real users, ideally at an organization that values engineering rigor.
 - Prior internships or roles at firms recognized for strong engineering practices.
 - Working fluency in Python for data handling and production-grade code.
 - Hands-on exposure to a major public cloud provider such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
 - A resume that opens with work history and quantifies outcomes in most bullet points, with degrees listed alongside GPA either on all or on none.
 Bonus points
 - Experience creating interactive reporting interfaces or charts for end users.
 - Familiarity with very large or intricate measurement datasets from research settings.
 - Skill building browser front ends with a component library and statically typed JavaScript.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: $90K to $185K
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Salt Lake City, UT, United States or San Mateo, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days in-office
 - Full-time
